note: Read 2026-10-31. Pakistan is kept by its regions; this is Sindh's. Sindh's own text of the Ordinance as the Sindh Code (Law Department) publishes it, the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 with the Sindh Adaptation of Laws Order, 1975 and Sindh Acts to XII of 2021: no one may drive a motorcar, otherwise than as a paid employee, until 18 (s. 4(1)(ii)); a private car licence is effective without renewal for up to three years (s. 11), a most and not a fixed term, so validYears is null. No fee was read (the DLS portal, dls.sindhpolice.gov.pk and dlsonline.sindhpolice.gov.pk, answer a Cloudflare challenge): fee null. The issuer is Sindh Police's Driving License Branch, as the Associated Press of Pakistan (the state news agency) reports its DSP in Shaheed Benazirabad (2 January 2026): learner and permanent licences issued daily through the Driving License Branch on the IG Sindh Police's directives.

sources.title: West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (Sindh Code, Law Department, Government of Sindh)
sources.said: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES ORDINANCE, 1965. ... Substituted for the words “West Pakistan” by Sindh Adaptation of Laws Order, 1975. ... a motorcar, otherwise than as paid employee, unless he has attained the age of eighteen years; ... be effective without renewal for a period up to three years in the case of licence to drive a motorcar or motorcycle otherwise than a paid employee ... Inserted new section by Sindh Act No. XII of 2021, dated 24th May, 2021.

sources.title: On the directives of IG Sindh Driving license being issued daily (Associated Press of Pakistan, 2 January 2026)
sources.said: DSP Driving License Branch, Shaheed Benazirabad, Ghulam Mustafa Baloch has said that, on the special directives of Inspector General of Sindh Police, the learning licenses and permanent driving licenses are being issued daily to drivers and citizens through the Driving License Branch
